Profiles
Each profile keeps its own separate training log — switch profiles from the pills on the main screen. "Kid" profiles get shorter durations (8-16 min) and gentler, medium-intensity routine styles instead of the adult ones. Saved to this device's browser storage; it won't follow you to a different phone or browser unless you're on a paid Claude plan viewing the published version, in which case it also syncs to your account.

Coach voice
Only English voices tagged UK, US, or Irish are listed here. This is limited to whatever your device/browser has installed — add more under: macOS/iOS Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices; Android Settings → Accessibility → Text-to-speech; Windows Settings → Time & Language → Speech. Reopen this page after installing a new one.
